definitions.explanation: Sharp, often shooting pain that runs along the course of a nerve, typically triggered by cold weather, pressure, or nerve damage. A common complaint associated with aging, and often discussed in everyday conversation about aches and pains.

examples.japanese: {神経痛|しんけいつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧。
⟦{寒|さむ}く→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{神経痛|しんけいつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: When it gets cold, I get neuralgia.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{神経痛|しんけいつう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悩|なや}まされている→悩ます：12602_nayamasu⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather has suffered from neuralgia in his lower back for many years.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧ ('nerve') and {痛|つう} ('pain'). Refers specifically to pain radiating along a nerve pathway, as distinct from muscle pain or joint pain. In casual speech, older speakers often use {神経痛|しんけいつう} to describe any persistent, weather-sensitive pain, even when the medical diagnosis is something else.

USAGE:
- Commonly paired with body-part modifiers: {坐骨|ざこつ}{神経痛|しんけいつう} (sciatica), {肋間|ろっかん}{神経痛|しんけいつう} (intercostal neuralgia), {三叉|さんさ}{神経痛|しんけいつう} (trigeminal neuralgia).
- Often described as appearing in cold weather or on rainy days; the folk association with weather is strong enough that people joke about using their neuralgia as a weather forecast.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {神経痛|しんけいつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have neuralgic pain
- {神経痛|しんけいつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: neuralgia flares up
- {神経痛|しんけいつう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悩|なや}まされる→悩ます：12602_nayamasu⟧: to suffer from neuralgia
- {神経痛|しんけいつう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{和|やわ}らげる→和らげる：07897_yawarageru⟧: to ease neuralgia
- {坐骨|ざこつ}{神経痛|しんけいつう}: sciatica

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{頭痛|ずつう}→頭痛：03369_zutsuu⟧: headache — pain in the head specifically.
- ⟦{腰痛|ようつう}→腰痛：05020_youtsuu⟧: lower back pain — a more general term that does not specify nerve involvement.
- ⟦{筋肉痛|きんにくつう}→筋肉痛：06298_kinnikutsuu⟧: muscle pain; soreness — typically from exercise, unrelated to nerves.
- ⟦{関節痛|かんせつつう}→関節痛：04651_kansetsutsuu⟧: joint pain — pain in the joints rather than along a nerve.
